voice.label: Professional female narrator (confident US / NYC business tone)

chapters.text: Welcome to Call IQ — the AI voice receptionist built for home service businesses that never want to miss a lead.
Every missed call is lost revenue. When your crew is on a job site, Call IQ answers instantly, qualifies callers, and books appointments — around the clock.
Configure intelligent voice agents that sound human, pull answers from your knowledge base, and hand off to your team when it matters.
Every caller is scored, tagged, and synced to your dashboard — Maria's kitchen leak, David's AC issue, Jennifer's panel upgrade — ready for follow-up.
Track 1,284 calls this month with 96% answer rate. See conversion trends, agent performance, and cost savings in one executive dashboard.
Call IQ checks Google Calendar or Outlook availability and books on the spot — like Maria's 2:30 PM plumbing visit or David's AC diagnostic at 3:30.
Every call outcome triggers CRM updates — contacts created in HubSpot, deals moved in Salesforce, call notes logged automatically.
Agencies and multi-location operators manage isolated orgs — separate numbers, agents, and billing — from one admin console.
Northline Home Services saves over $3,000 monthly versus a full-time receptionist while capturing 49% more qualified leads. Start your free trial at hallaai.com.
Start your free trial at hallaai.com — fourteen days, no credit card. Enter your name, work email, password, and company name.
Call IQ sends a confirmation link to your inbox — not a code. Click the link to verify your account, then continue to setup.
The onboarding wizard starts with your business. Enter Northline Home Services, your services, and set your timezone to Mountain.
Select every industry you serve — HVAC, plumbing, and electrical — so your AI uses the right vocabulary on every call.
Set working days and hours. Your AI still answers twenty-four seven, but tells callers when your team is available.
Name your AI receptionist Sarah, choose a professional personality, and preview the voice callers will hear.
Search area code 720, claim +1 (720) 555-0188, and your AI line is live — included on your free trial.
You're all set. Sarah is ready for Northline Home Services on a fourteen-day trial with sixty included minutes. Run a test call, then open your dashboard.
Your dashboard shows forty-seven calls today, twenty-three leads, eight appointments, and a forty-nine percent conversion rate.
Marcus Chen at Summit Comfort HVAC creates an HVAC receptionist named Morgan — inbound type, cedar voice, calm and knowledgeable tone.
Upload service guides, maintenance plan pricing, warranty policies, and financing sheets. Call IQ indexes every page for RAG during live calls.
Point Call IQ at https://summitcomforthvac.com. It crawled 52 pages — services, service areas, and seasonal promotions — synced every Monday.
Add approved FAQ answers for hours, brands serviced, tune-up pricing, service areas, and financing — Morgan uses these as source of truth.
Set Morgan's calm, knowledgeable tone and craft the opening greeting callers hear on every inbound call.
Core instructions tell Morgan to collect address and callback number, prioritize no-cool emergencies, and never quote exact replacement prices.
Configure Boulder business hours and after-hours emergency dispatch — $89 trip fee for no-heat and no-cool emergencies.
Escalate on keywords like manager, warranty dispute, or legal inquiry. Notify dispatch via SMS and email when sentiment turns negative.
Route dispatch, sales, and emergency lines. When a caller asks for a manager, Morgan transfers to dispatch within 3 seconds.
90-minute diagnostic slots, 4-hour minimum notice for standard visits, immediate dispatch for emergencies, and SMS reminders with tech en-route alerts.
Run a no-cool emergency scenario: 92 degrees, newborn at home. Morgan flags same-day dispatch and collects address — score 97%.
Review simulation transcripts. Call number 2 flagged for quoting exact replacement price — update instructions before going live.
After 3 instruction updates and 2 new FAQs, re-test scores hit 96%. Morgan goes live on +1 (303) 555-0147 — monitor the first 50 calls.
Search Denver area code 720 or Boulder 303. Purchase a local number in minutes — no carrier contracts or porting delays.
Assign +1 (720) 555-0188 to Main Receptionist and +1 (720) 555-0199 to Sales Agent. Each number loads its agent's knowledge base and personality.
Configure business-hours routing to AI, after-hours emergency dispatch, manager transfers, and voicemail fallback with SMS alerts.
Place three test calls: AI answered in 1.2 seconds, sales transfer connected, after-hours SMS alert delivered. All passed — go live.
Maria calls about a kitchen leak. Sarah qualifies urgency, captures her address on Tennyson Street, and tags the lead as emergency plumbing.
Sarah checks Carlos's availability and books Maria for 2:30 PM today — no hold music, no callback queue.
HubSpot creates Maria Gonzalez as a contact, logs the full transcript, and sets deal stage to Appointment Scheduled.
Maria receives an SMS: Northline Home Services — plumbing visit confirmed today 2:30 PM. Tech: Carlos V. Reply RESCHEDULE to change.
A Google Calendar event appears on dispatch's calendar with address, service type, and linked HubSpot contact.
Five automated steps — qualify, book, sync CRM, confirm via SMS, create calendar event — zero manual data entry from call to dispatch.
Northline Home Services handled 1,284 inbound calls this month — 96% answered with an average duration of 3 minutes 48 seconds.
Only 51 missed calls — down 32% from last month. 63% were after hours; 78% recovered via callback or SMS follow-up.
49% conversion rate generated 634 qualified leads and 296 booked appointments — up 22% and 15% respectively.
296 appointments booked with an 88.2% show rate. Only 7% rescheduled — most common services: HVAC diagnostic and emergency plumbing.
Sarah scores 96% satisfaction on 892 calls. Alex handles sales qualification at 91%. Escalation rate dropped to 3.8%.
At $149 per month versus $3,200 for a full-time receptionist, Northline saves $3,051 monthly — a 95% cost reduction with higher lead capture.
Connect HubSpot — 412 contacts synced this month. Maria Gonzalez created automatically; David Chen's call logged with transcript.
Salesforce maps Call IQ leads to Contacts and Opportunities with custom fields for transcript, lead score, and service type.
Zoho CRM syncs SMB leads like James Okonkwo's maintenance plan inquiry — ideal for teams already on Zoho One.
Google Calendar sync creates events in real time — David's 3:30 PM diagnostic and Maria's 2:30 PM plumbing visit booked during calls.
Microsoft Outlook integration checks dispatch calendar availability for commercial jobs and team scheduling.
Two active webhook endpoints — ServiceTitan job creation and Slack dispatch alerts — delivered 1,847 events this month with 3 failures.
